maya: Heads up: after the handbook shuffle I found two bad anchor links on the FAQ page. The deploy subsection is no longer reachable via /handbook/faq#deploy and the Docker snippet still uses the old var.

sam: Do you have the exact line for the snippet?

maya: snippet shows:
```bash
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY="$KEY" redwood/inference:latest
```
should be REDWOOD_API_TOKEN now and the anchor slug could be more stable like `faq-deploy`.

oliver: I can patch. plan: update snippet, rename anchors to `faq-deploy`, add 301 redirect for old hashes, and add a staging smoke-check that hits the anchor. I'll open a PR.

tess: tagging docs-owners: can someone confirm redirect strategy? we prefer 301 for public links and keep internal rewrites separate.

maya: +1 on the smoke-check. add a tiny curl that verifies the HTML fragment resolves.

oliver: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1101 "FAQ: fix deploy anchor + docker env var + redirect". Added nginx redirect snippet and a one-liner smoke test in CI.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by oliver at 2024-08-07T15:42:10Z  staging build 8019

maya: will validate once staging finishes.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy finished at 2024-08-07T15:44:20Z  build 8019

maya: checked: anchor works, snippet now shows `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN`, smoke test passes. sam can you review the nginx mapping?

sam: on it, will post LGTM or comments in the PR in ~15m.

oliver: thanks all, will merge after LGTM and cut a short changelog note.
